Package info5.sar.EventBasedMessageQueue.Impl

package info5.sar.EventBasedMessageQueue.Impl
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    InternalAcceptListener
    This class serves as an intermediary between the accepted channel and the core message-handling logic, providing additional setup before delegating to the wrapped IAcceptListener.
    InternalChannelListener
    InternalChannelListener is an implementation of the IChannelListener interface responsible for handling message transmission and reception over a given IChannel.
    InternalConnectListener
    InternalConnectListener is an implementation of the IConnectListener interface.
    MessageQueue
    MessageQueue is an implementation of the IMessageQueue interface, providing a mechanism to send and receive messages over an IChannel with structured handling of message events.
    QueueBroker
    QueueBroker is an implementation of the IQueueBroker interface that wraps an internal Broker instance to provide message queue-specific binding and connection management.
